definitions.explanation: A rate or percentage paid as compensation, especially for sales.
A ratio or percentage in general contexts.

examples.japanese: {歩合制|ぶあいせい}で{働|はたら}いている。
{売上|うりあげ}の10%が{歩合|ぶあい}として{支払|しはら}われる。
examples.english: 10% of sales is paid as commission.

examples.japanese: {歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}だから、{頑張|がんば}れば{頑張|がんば}るほど{収入|しゅうにゅう}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: Since it's commission-based pay, the harder I work, the more I earn.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}の{歩合|ぶあい}が{高|たか}い{方法|ほうほう}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: Choose a method with a high success rate.

examples.japanese: {不動産|ふどうさん}{仲介|ちゅうかい}の{歩合|ぶあい}は{通常|つうじょう}3%だ。
examples.english: The commission for real estate brokerage is usually 3%.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{歩合|ぶあい}がいいので{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This job is popular because the commission rate is good.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{歩合制|ぶあいせい} - commission-based system
・{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう} - commission-based pay
・{歩合|ぶあい}がいい - good commission rate

USAGE:
Often used in sales, real estate, and other industries where compensation is tied to performance.

COMPARISON:
・{歩合|ぶあい} - commission rate (Japanese term)
・コミッション - commission (loanword, also common)
・{手数料|てすうりょう} - handling fee, service charge
・{割合|わりあい} - ratio, proportion (more general)
